title: 第一卷 第27章 请客
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
老太太挂好水。

    村医说道：“春妮啊，还是要带着你奶去县里医院好好检查检查。”

    张春妮点点头。

    老太太说道：“去什么县里。”

    “你别胡说。”

    “我来你这里挂水，你不也有钱赚。”

    村医被教训的苦笑不已，说道：“我这不是听大家都说春妮赶海赚了钱嘛。”

    老太太说道：“钱也不能都糟蹋到我身上啊。”

    “这赚钱多不容易。”

    村医摇头。

    村里人都知道这一对苦瓜婆孙俩有多难。

    张春妮说道：“奶奶，你不用担心钱，我明天还去赶海，一定也能赚到钱，等攒够钱，我就带你去县里。”

    老太太：“不去。”

    张春妮：“去。”

    村医也劝道：“你看看春妮多孝顺，你要是不去，那不是让你孙女不孝嘛。”

    老太太拉着张春妮赶紧走，让后者不要听村医胡说八道。

    村医摇头。

    他的医术是个什么水平，自个清楚，一个赤脚医生能有多大能耐，这药水，也就是消炎止疼。

    管得了一时，别说去根，连治标都够不上。

    再这么耽搁下去。

    老太太怕是没多少时日了。

    ……

    另一边。

    张秋月骑着自行车，一路到了老屋，车子刚停下，李华正好从屋里出来，手里拎着个破水桶。

    浑身脏兮兮的。

    张秋月嫌弃的看着，问道：“你在屋里干嘛呢？”

    李华看到她，眉头一挑：“打扫。”

    “你怎么来了？”

    张秋月把车停好，开门见山的问道：“李华，你还问我怎么来了，我问你，张秋月怎么一点事都没有？”

    “我不是让你把她弄伤的嘛？”

    “尤其是要让她磕破脸皮。”

    “结果，她不仅没事，还赚了很多钱！”

    “哦，你说这个啊。”李华拍拍手上的灰，一点也不慌，随口道：“今天不是没机会嘛，礁石滩那边人多，不好下手。”

    “真的？”

    “我骗你干嘛？不过你放心，我答应了帮你，肯定帮你。”李华摆出诚意，说道：“你自己想想，我追你那么久，什么时候不是有求必应，说到做到的？”

    张秋月将信将疑，但李华这话说的也是事实，问道：“那接下来你打算怎么办？”
content_en:
The old lady hung up the water.

    The village doctor said: "Chunni, I still need to take your milk to the county hospital for a good check-up."

    Zhang Chunni nodded.

    The old lady said: "Which county are you going to?"

    "Don't talk nonsense."

    "If I come here to hang out with you, you will also make money."

    The village doctor laughed bitterly after being taught a lesson, and said, "Didn't I hear everyone say that Chunni made money by going to sea?"

    The old lady said: "You can't waste all the money on me."

    "It's not easy to make money."

    The village doctor shook his head.

    Everyone in the village knows how difficult it is for the mother-in-law and grandson.

    Zhang Chunni said: "Grandma, you don't have to worry about money. I will go to the sea tomorrow and I will definitely make money. When I save enough money, I will take you to the county."

    Old lady: "I won't go."

    Zhang Chunni: "Go."

    The village doctor also advised: "Look at how filial Chun Ni is. If you don't go, then your granddaughter will be unfilial."

    The old lady pulled Zhang Chunni away quickly, telling the latter not to listen to the village doctor's nonsense.

    The village doctor shook his head.

    I know the level of his medical skills and how capable a barefoot doctor can be. This potion is an anti-inflammatory and analgesic.

    It can be managed for a while, but it cannot even cure the symptoms, let alone remove the root.

    If you continue to delay like this.

    The old lady is afraid she doesn't have much time left.

    …

    other side.

    Zhang Qiuyue rode her bicycle all the way to the old house. As soon as the car stopped, Li Hua happened to come out of the house, carrying a broken bucket in his hand.

    Dirty all over.

    Zhang Qiuyue looked at it with disgust and asked, "What are you doing in the house?"

    Li Hua raised his eyebrows when he saw her: "Cleaning."

    "Why are you here?"

    Zhang Qiuyue parked the car and asked straight to the point: "Li Hua, you asked me why I came here. Let me ask you, why is Zhang Qiuyue okay?"

    "Didn't I ask you to hurt her?"

    "Especially to make her lose face."

    "As a result, not only was she fine, she also made a lot of money!"

    "Oh, you said this." Li Hua patted the dust on his hands and said casually without panicking: "There is no chance today. There are many people on the reef beach, so it is difficult to start."

    "Really?"

    "Why did I lie to you? But don't worry, I promised to help you and I will definitely help you." Li Hua showed his sincerity and said: "Think about it for yourself, I have been chasing you for so long, when did I not always respond to your requests and do what I say?"

    Zhang Qiuyue was doubtful, but what Li Hua said was true, and asked: "Then what are you going to do next?"
